sources.supports: OpenAI states researchers may apply for up to $1,000 API credits, valid for 12 months; reviews occur quarterly in March, June, September and December; early-stage and resource-limited researchers are encouraged. Areas include alignment, fairness, societal impact, misuse, human-AI interaction, economic impact, generalization and multimodal measurement.

OpenAI's July 29 announcement describes free access for selected institutions, up to four collaborators, business-grade data protections and expansion to 100,000 researchers through 2027. August 10 update says new applicants join a waitlist pending allocation of initial seats. The OpenAI Help Center specifies faculty or postdoctoral status, supported countries, affiliation verification and an authored preprint from the past three years in eligible fields; access is 12 months and does not include API credits.
Anthropic's August 27, 2026 update says researchers may apply for up to $50,000 in Claude credits per project and broadens beyond biology. Specialized themed calls can have distinct deadlines.

Anthropic opened 10,000 scientist seats; standard seats are free and premium 5x-usage seats cost $15/month for one year. A PI or equivalent at an academic or nonprofit institution must verify and can add lab researchers.

Current job page lists January cohort applications due October 18, rolling review, four months full-time, $3,850 USD weekly stipend, about $15,000 monthly compute and research expenses, and required work authorization in the U.S., U.K. or Canada with no visa sponsorship.
